receipt.public_excerpt: 第四条 提供和使用生成式人工智能服务，应当遵守法律、行政法规，尊重社会公德和伦理道德，遵守以下规定：

evidence_items.explanation: The official CAC text makes Article 4 a mandatory rule ('应当', shall) for providing and using generative AI services. The measures took effect on 2023-08-15. Item (1) of Article 4 requires adherence to core socialist values (see e2).

evidence_items.publisher: Sidley Austin (translation of CAC Interim Measures)

receipt.public_excerpt:
(1) Adhere to the core socialist values, and shall not incite subversion of state power, overthrow the socialist system, endanger national security and
interests, damage the national image

evidence_items.explanation: English translation of the binding rule. Generative AI services must adhere to core socialist values and must not produce content that subverts state power or the socialist system. This is a legal requirement to conform to Party ideology.

receipt.public_excerpt: AI companies in China are undergoing a government review of their large language models, aimed at ensuring they "embody core socialist values," according to a report by the Financial Times.

evidence_items.explanation: Shows the regulator was enforcing the requirement on LLMs in 2024, well before the June 2025 post.
